name: Meta Eagle Mountain

timeline.event: We believe Buildings 1 and 2 are still undergoing testing due to construction equipment and unfinished land surrounding the data center sites, as well as color motion artifacts on a small number of the cooling fans.
Buildings 1 and 2 both estimated to be operational 90 days after testing was underway in September.
Satellite image shows strong evidence that Buildings 1 and 2 are operational: colored motion artifacts on many cooling fans, plus cars parked at the building entrances.

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)
sources.quote: Meta Eagle Mountain: current power 133 MW; owner Meta.

explain: Meta Eagle Mountain is an operating AI data center in Eagle Mountain, UT, owned by meta. Epoch AI estimates it draws 133 MW today and 179 MW when finished.
